name: Post-Release Monitoring and Audit
purpose: Define controlled post-release monitoring, exception management, auditability, corrective action and evidence succession for any batch that is actually authorized and released. No monitoring record may imply that a release occurred when empirical release evidence is absent.

actions: place affected scope on HOLD where warranted
create successor DMRV package/anchor if evidence changes

audit_principles: monitoring observations retain evidence class and provenance
material discrepancies are not silently overwritten
release scope is never generalized beyond its authorized boundary
fail_closed_conditions: release record absent when claiming released status
successor evidence not linked after material correction
permissible_claims: a released batch is being monitored when release is empirically recorded
an exception has been opened and its status can be reported
prohibited_claims: absence of an incident proves compliance
future batches inherit prior release status
